question: Which terrible strength-destroying guardian is stationed in the western direction?
premises: A guardian called strength-destroyer is named.
A guardian called terrible is named.
This guardian is situated in the west.
inference: The terrible strength-destroyer is stationed in the western direction.
uncertainties: It is unclear whether Balanāśa and Bhīṣaṇa are one figure or two.
plain_english: The strength-destroyer and the terrible one are situated in the west.
